The structure of Mg2Co4Sb8O24 (reduced formula MgCo2(SbO3)4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 148), with 38 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg and Sb centers adopt eight-coordinate oxygen environments. The Co octahedra share corners with one another and with Sb polyhedra, and these corner-sharing relations are identified as a validated periodic pattern. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, with a single connected component spanning all 38 sites.
